name: The Misericordia Church and part of the Senate House, Macao
dimensions: Dimensions taken from <u>Victoria & Albert Museum Department of Prints and Drawings and Department of Paintings, Accessions 1928. </u> London: HMSO, 1929
summary: A drawing of the entrance to the church of Santa Casa da Misericórdia ('the Holy House of Mercy') in Senado Square, Macau; the Casa remains but was rebuilt in a classical style in c. 1905.
